build_wam_model: build a WAM model that combines an embedder, detector, and augmenter for watermarking images
test_wam_forward: test the WAM model forward pass that generates watermarked images, augments them, and detects watermarks
test_wam_embed: test the WAM model embed method that generates watermarked images from input images and messages for inference
test_wam_detect: test the WAM model detect method that rescales images and computes watermark masks and messages
test_wam_get_random_msg: test the WAM model get_random_msg method that generates random binary messages for watermarking
